meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

copy.tagline: 将工作分解为可执行的系统步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将复杂目标拆解为有条理的行动步骤
copy.tagline_en: Decompose work into systematic, actionable steps

howto.what: Claude 会按照 ultrawork 模式将工作目标分解成系统化的、基于证据的步骤，并管理一个带检查点的循环流程，确保每一步都有可观测的实证，并委托子代理处理代码编写和测试等任务。
howto.when: 当用户提及“ulw-loop”、“ulw”、持久目标执行、证据驱动工作、手动 QA 或带检查点的长时间交付时。

say.text: 使用 ulw-loop 模式处理这个项目。
say.note: Claude 将启动分解和证据循环。

say.text: 帮我用 ulw 方法分解这个任务并设置检查点。
say.note: 将创建目标和步骤列表。

say.text: 我想进行带手动 QA 的持久目标执行。

howto.what_en: Claude decomposes the user's goal into systematic, evidence-bound steps using ultrawork mode, manages a checkpointed loop, ensures each step has observable evidence, and delegates code writing/testing to subagents.
howto.when_en: When the user mentions "ulw-loop", "ulw", durable goal execution, evidence-led work, manual QA, or checkpointed long-running delivery.

say_en.text: Handle this project using ulw-loop mode.
say_en.note: Claude initiates the decomposition and evidence loop.

say_en.text: Decompose this task with ulw and set up checkpoints.
say_en.note: Goals and step checklist will be created.

say_en.text: I want durable goal execution with manual QA.
